|joke=Stop motion is the film technique of moving a model a little between frames. The tauntauns in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' were animated by Phil Tippett with go motion, a form of stop-motion animation. The lore is the warning that Han's tauntaun will freeze, that is, stop moving. StarWars.com shows Tippett with the stop-motion tauntaun puppet.<ref name="b13-swc-hoth">[https://www.starwars.com/news/hoth-behind-the-scenes Creating a Winter Wonderland on Hoth], StarWars.com.
